# Shuttle Piping

Shuttle Piping is an accountless Cloudflare Workers rendezvous transfer web tool at https://p2p.gorustai.com/.

It helps users move short notes, code snippets, terminal output, configuration text, and small files between phones, browsers, containers, and terminals.

Core workflows:

- Browser text sharing: paste text, create a 6-digit key, open the key or link on another device, and read or copy the text inline.
- Browser file sharing: choose one or more files, create a transfer key, scan a QR code or open a link, and download on the receiver.
- Terminal transfer: use curl with PUT or POST to send data to a unique path, then GET the same path from the receiving device.
- Direct or link mode: direct mode uses a short key; link mode creates a receive link and QR code.

Important properties:

- Runs on Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects for rendezvous coordination.
- Provides a P2P-style handoff workflow, but traffic is relayed through Cloudflare Workers instead of direct WebRTC browser-to-browser connectivity.
- No account is required for the public tool.
- Transfers are intended for text and small files within Cloudflare request upload limits.
- 6-digit browser sessions expire after 10 minutes.
- The project is open source at https://github.com/thomas7725353/shuttle-piping.

Useful URLs:

- App: https://p2p.gorustai.com/app
- Health check: https://p2p.gorustai.com/status
- Source code: https://github.com/thomas7725353/shuttle-piping

Example curl usage:

```bash
echo "Hello from Shuttle Piping" | curl -T - https://p2p.gorustai.com/YOUR-TRANSFER-NAME
curl https://p2p.gorustai.com/YOUR-TRANSFER-NAME
```

Both sides must use the same unique transfer path. Replace `YOUR-TRANSFER-NAME` with a name that is hard for other users to guess.
